verdict.rationale: Stripe documents creating, customizing (content and branding), and sending Stripe-hosted invoices, plus automated tax compliance, which covers the core invoicing part of the story. Automatic delivery is less certain: per a Stripe PM, customer emails are off by default, and one community team said Stripe lacked the email invoicing Recurly offers. Missing for 10: evidence of credit notes, receipts, sequential invoice numbering, explicit custom fields and memos, confirmed automatic customer delivery, and independent hands-on corroboration.
